name: WAPPLOADER – WordPress Auto Page PreLoader
author: Adnan Hyder Pervez

sections.description:
🚀 WAPPLOADER – WordPress Auto Page PreLoader

Give your visitors a smooth, engaging experience with WAPPLOADER, the best WordPress preloader plugin designed to display a stylish loading animation before your content appears. Instead of making visitors stare at a blank page, WAPPLOADER keeps them entertained with an animated loader—helping reduce bounce rate and improve user satisfaction.

🌟 Why Use a WordPress Preloader?

A website preloader isn’t just visual decoration—it serves a real purpose in user experience:
– Improve Perceived Performance: Distracts users with motion while the page loads.
– Reduce Bounce Rates: Users are less likely to leave during a “blank screen” moment.
– Strengthen Branding: Display your logo, brand colors, or background image as the page loads.
– Engage Mobile Users: Designed to be lightweight and responsive on all devices.

If you’ve ever searched “how to add a loading screen in WordPress” or “best responsive preloader plugin,” you’ve just found your answer.

🎨 Customize Every Detail

WAPPLOADER offers a live preview admin panel so you can fine-tune:
– Logo / Loader Image: Upload your own image or logo.
– Loader Dimensions: Default 250×250px, but adjustable.
– Duration Setting: Control how long the preloader stays after page load.
– Background: Choose solid color, gradient, or custom image.
– Background Controls: Position (top, center, bottom, etc.) and size (cover, contain, auto).
– Animations: Sleek effect fills the loader smoothly as your site content loads.
sections.installation:
1. Download the WAPPLOADER plugin .zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the .zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click Activate Plugin.
  6. Navigate to WAPPLOADER in your WordPress dashboard to configure settings.
sections.faq:
1. Can I disable the pre-loader on specific pages?

Currently, the pre-loader is enabled site-wide. A per-page option may be added in future updates.

2. What happens if I set both a background color and a background image?

The plugin will automatically disable background color when a background image is selected.

3. Can I change the speed of the animation?

The duration setting allows you to control how long the loader remains after the page has loaded.

4. Will this slow down my site?

No. WAPPLOADER uses lightweight CSS and JavaScript for animations. It runs asynchronously and removes itself once loading completes.
